positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: As an engineer on the Platform Engineering Team, my responsibilities include working on core libraries and services that allow the product teams to build and operate quickly and efficiently. I work on applications and libraries in Java (via the Spring Boot framework) and TypeScript (via NestJS) on the back end as well as UI tools in Angularr

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on new features and bug fixes for a project with a microservice-based architecture
        - Tech stack included NodeJS, Grails, AngularJS, React, Android, Docker, and MySQL
        - Services communicated with each other via REST, with devices via gRPC and MQTT
  - Developed a remote wifi settings feature
      - Customers could set up wireless networks on their hardware devices via the web UI
      - Wireless networks were sent to devices over the air via gRPC

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Worked closely with business analysts and customers to develop new features and bug fixes for a full stack web application
- Added functionality and performance improvements to Java batch process application
- Planned out, led, and completed conversion of web frontend from AngularJS (1.4) to Angular 9
    - Conversion was completed by hybridizing the frontend, which allowed for new development and bug fixes while conversion was taking place
- Integrated web application features with Amazon Web Services, including Lambda, Simple Queue Service, Simple Notification Service, and S3 buckets
- Closed security vulnerabilities identified by the InfoSec team

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
- Developed tools, visualizations, and scripts for the team
- Added features to the team’s large server application
- Developed an SDK for REST API clients
- Provided support to system testers and put in fixes for defects
- Wrote and performed functional tests for team applications
- Automated test cases for regression testing
positions.insights: Representational State Transfer (REST), SoapUI and +5 skills
